capabilities: Paste clipboard highlights as info cards via a custom paste hotkey
Auto-detect the source URL from clipboard HTML data
Convert selected editor text into a card via a command
Switch card output between callout, code block, and embed formats
Choose card visual styles (modern, minimal, classic) and toggle a source badge
disambiguation: Not a web clipper; it formats text you have already copied and does not fetch or archive web pages itself.
extras: README is written in heavy internet slang (Chinese and English editions) but covers install, usage, settings, and clipboard-source extraction details per browser; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Copying highlighted text from a browser into Obsidian produces messy formatting and loses the source URL, requiring manual cleanup.
summary: Paste web highlights into Obsidian as formatted info cards with the source URL auto-detected from the clipboard.
